# Parse the archive file content to extract song titles and artists.
archive_content = archive_file['content']
lines = archive_content.split('\n')
archive_songs = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    # Format: "- Song Title by Artist"
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
    # Split on " by " (case sensitive? The file uses " by ")
    if ' by ' in line:
        title, artist = line.split(' by ', 1)
        archive_songs.append((title.strip(), artist.strip()))
    else:
        # Maybe just title? But we'll assume format.
        pass
print(f"Parsed {len(archive_songs)} songs from archive file.")
for t, a in archive_songs:
    print(f"Title: {t}, Artist: {a}")
